lines.japanese: さて、どうすっかな……バイト始まるまで、若干の時間があるんだよな。コンビニで麻雀漫画でも立ち読みしてくるか。
lines.english: What now...? I had a little time before work. Maybe I'd go stand around reading mahjong comics for free at the convenience store.

lines.japanese: それとも立ち飲み屋でイイカンジに酔ってるおばちゃんでも冷やかしに行くか、あるいは風俗案内所のおっちゃんに最近のユニークな性産業でも紹介してもらうか、んじゃなかったら……
lines.english: Or I could go needle some happily tipsy middle-aged woman at a standing bar, or ask the old guy at the red-light guide booth what strange new things the sex industry had cooked up lately, or else...

lines.japanese: 「あーっ、隼人君だあ！」
lines.english: “Hey! It's Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 俺は首ごと視線を外し、進路上にあった喋る障害物を避けて歩きつづけた。いやあ、どうしたもんかねえ、この孤独な夜。
lines.english: I turned my eyes away—head and all—and kept walking, steering around the talking obstacle in my path. Ah, what was a man to do with this lonely night?

lines.japanese: すた、すた、すた……。
lines.english: Step, step, step...

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ……！　ちょおっとー！」
lines.english: “Hey...! Heeey!”

lines.japanese: 「なーんで！　も、逃げんなしー！　マジはてな、ありえない、信じらんない！」
lines.english: “Whyyy?! Don’t run away! Seriously, what? This makes no sense! No way! I can’t believe this!”

lines.japanese: 追ってきた香田が後ろから俺の腕を掴んで、くるっと正面に回りこんだ。
lines.english: Koda chased me down, grabbed my arm from behind, and swung around to block my path.

lines.japanese: 相変わらず香水が甘ったるい。俺はあからさまに顔をしかめた。
lines.english: Her perfume was sickly sweet as ever. I grimaced openly.

lines.japanese: 「あぁ……へえ、いたの」
lines.english: “Oh... Huh. You were here?”

lines.japanese: 「ばっち目ぇ合ったじゃん、いまー！　ちょーイミフだし、も、なんで逃げんの！」
lines.english: “We totally made eye contact just now! That made, like, zero sense! Why’d you run away?”

lines.japanese: 「なんで……あれ、なんでだ。まあ、なんとなく」
lines.english: “Why...? Wait, why did I? Dunno. Just felt like it.”

lines.japanese: 「なんとなくう！？」
lines.english: “Just felt like it?!”

lines.japanese: 香田はリアクション芸人のように前のめりで吠えた。擦れちがう通行人の視線を感じて俺は肩をすぼめる。
lines.english: Koda pitched forward and bellowed like a variety-show comic doing a reaction bit. People passing by started looking, and I hunched my shoulders.

lines.japanese: 「だって、おまえらといんの恥ずかしいんだもん」
lines.english: “Because being seen with you people is embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: 「ハァーーーー！？」
lines.english: “Whaaaaaat?!”

lines.japanese: 「いや……だからそういう……」
lines.english: “See... that. Exactly that.”

lines.japanese: 「なにそれ！　なにそれ恥ずかしいとか、フツーゆう？　ゆわないでしょ、ありえなくない？　女の子にそんな口利くとか、隼人君ちょっと失礼すぎじゃない？」
lines.english: “What is that supposed to mean? Who just tells a girl she's embarrassing? Nobody, that's who! You can't seriously think it's okay to talk to a girl like that. That is so rude, Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな。じゃ年上にタメ口利いてるおまえだって似たようなもんだろ」
lines.english: “Shut up. You talk to an older guy like he's your buddy, so you're no better.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 香田の体が虚を衝かれたように固まった。
lines.english: Koda went rigid. I had caught her completely off guard.

lines.japanese: 「あ……すい、ません」
lines.english: “Oh... I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: やつは真顔でちょいっと頭を下げる。俺はうしろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: Her face turned solemn, and she gave me a tiny bow. I raked my fingers through the hair at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「あー、いい、いい。冗談だから。俺そーゆーの気にしないから」
lines.english: “Nah, forget it. I was kidding. I don't care about that stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「そう……ですか？」
lines.english: “You... don't?”

lines.japanese: 「先に生まれたからって無条件に偉いわけでもねーじゃん、学校とか会社みたいな縦社会ン中ならともかく」
lines.english: “Being born first doesn’t automatically make anybody better. Maybe inside a hierarchy like a school or a company, but not out here.”

lines.japanese: 「だあよねえ！　うちら友達だもんねえ！」
lines.english: “Exactly! We're friends, right?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、友達んなった覚えはねーけど」
lines.english: “I don't remember becoming friends.”

lines.japanese: 「友達以上か」
lines.english: “More than friends, then.”

lines.japanese: 「以下だっつの」
lines.english: “Less than friends, I said.”

lines.japanese: 「算数だと以下にはそれも含まれるですよ？」
lines.english: “In math, ‘less than or equal to’ still includes ‘equal to,’ you know?”

lines.japanese: 生意気な小娘は、意外に白い歯を見せて笑う。わりとうざい。俺は舌打ちしてメンチきった。
lines.english: The cheeky little brat grinned, flashing surprisingly white teeth. Pretty damn annoying. I clicked my tongue and gave her my best death glare.

lines.japanese: 「まーまー。友達どーし仲良くやりましょうよ」
lines.english: “Come on, now. Let's be good friends and get along.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、だからソレやめろって。おまえの敬語キモい」
lines.english: “Shut up. I told you to knock that off. Your polite voice creeps me out.”

lines.japanese: 「キモいゆーなあ！」
lines.english: “Don't call it creepy!”

lines.japanese: せせらぎみたいな裏拳が俺の胸を打った。軽く無視して、俺の視線はやつの頭を超えた。しかし、その辺りに立ってるはずと思われたツレの姿がない。
lines.english: Her backhand landed on my chest with all the force of a babbling brook. I ignored it and looked over her head. The companion I'd expected to find nearby was nowhere in sight.

lines.japanese: 「あれ……香田、あいつは、ロンゲはどうした」
lines.english: “Wait... Koda, where's that guy? Longhair?”

lines.japanese: 「カズ君？　なんで私に聞くん？」
lines.english: “Kazu? Why ask me?”

lines.japanese: どうやら今日は一緒じゃないらしい。
lines.english: Apparently they weren't together today.

lines.japanese: 「べつに。知らなきゃいいんだけど」
lines.english: “No reason. If you don't know, forget it.”

lines.japanese: もちろん会いたかったわけじゃない。むしろ会ってもろくなことはない。
lines.english: Not like I wanted to see him. If anything, seeing him never led to anything good.

lines.japanese: 「いや、なんつーの。あいつさ、なんか、昨日とかヘンじゃなかった。ビミョーにいじけてるっつーか、やさぐれてるっつーか。アレなに、おまえとケンカでもしたの」
lines.english: “It's just... Wasn't he acting weird yesterday? Kind of sulky, kind of pissed at the world. What was that about? Did you two have a fight?”

lines.japanese: 「あのさあ」
lines.english: “Listen.”

lines.japanese: 見下ろすと、香田がさりげなく描きたされた眉山を吊りあげていた。
lines.english: I looked down to see Koda arching her subtly penciled eyebrows.

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なに」
lines.english: “Huh? What?”

lines.japanese: 「前からちょっと気になってたんだけどー、隼人君なんか誤解してない？　ません？」
lines.english: “This has kinda been bugging me for a while. Have you maybe got the wrong idea about something, Hayato... sir?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、敬語いいってば」
lines.english: “I said forget the polite speech.”

lines.japanese: 「あのね？　いま違うけど、うちとカズ君ちは１０年以上ずーっと団地の隣同士だったですよ」
lines.english: “Look, Kazu's family lived next door to mine in the apartment complex for over ten years. Not anymore, but they did... sir.”

lines.japanese: 「てめえ、敬語いいつってんじゃないですかブッ殺しますよコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Would you kindly knock off the polite crap before I murder you, you bastard?”

lines.japanese: 「なんで、ずっと家族ぐるみのお付きあいがあってー。そんで今もうちら、友達ってゆうか……友達？　んん？　違うか、親友？　仲間？　なんだ？」
lines.english: “So our families have always been close. And now we're, like... friends? Friends? Hmm, no. Best friends? Buddies? What are we?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、俺に聞かれても」
lines.english: “Don't ask me.”

lines.japanese: 「んー、ワカランけどなんか……イトコ？　従兄妹か、そだ、従兄妹っぽいかもしんない。うん、そーじゃん。え、だってだって知ってる？　うちら赤ちゃんのときからずっと一緒だったんだよ？」
lines.english: “Hmm. I dunno, but maybe... cousins? Yeah, cousins. Maybe we're basically cousins. That's it. I mean, did you know we've been together since we were babies?”

lines.japanese: 「出会いとかないの、すごくない？　なんか気付いたら居たしカズ君。ね、そんなんパパとかお兄ちゃんと同じでしょ？　私も向こうも、両方の家フツーに出入りしてたし、もうこれフツーに親族だって」
lines.english: “Isn't it crazy that we don't even have a ‘when we met’? Kazu was just there before I knew it. That's the same as my dad or my brother, right? I was always in and out of his house, he was always in and out of mine—at that point, we're basically family.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ聞くけどさ、隼人君だったら親族と付きあえんの？　ありえないでしょ？　親族はないでしょ？　ね、ないない無理無理ぜったい無理。これカズ君だって、ぜったい同じことゆーよ」
lines.english: “So let me ask you: could you date somebody who's basically family? Obviously not, right? Family is out. No way. Impossible. Absolutely impossible. Kazu would tell you the exact same thing.”

lines.japanese: だらだらと女はそう言うが、俺はこれまでに、男の方から否定の言葉を聞いたことはなかった。
lines.english: She kept rambling, but I'd never once heard the guy deny any of it.

lines.japanese: ふとこの男女の相関図が浮かんだ。森里和馬と香田亜衣。矢印は互いに向きあっている。しかし同じなのは太さだけで、色が違う。香田のハートマーク付き桃色矢印は、幼馴染みではない誰かへ向かって──
lines.english: For a moment, a chart of the two of them took shape in my mind. Kazuma Morisato and Ai Koda. An arrow ran in each direction, both equally thick—but they weren't the same color. Koda's pink, heart-studded arrow pointed past her childhood friend toward somebody else—

lines.japanese: ──なんつって、仮説仮説。がんばれ森里。
lines.english: —or whatever. A theory. Just a theory. Good luck, Morisato.

lines.japanese: くそ、聞かなきゃよかった。そうだ、聞かなかったことにしよう。
lines.english: Damn. I should never have asked. Fine. I hadn't heard any of that.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっとー、聞いてますかー」
lines.english: “Heeey. Are you listening?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、あんまり」
lines.english: “Not really.”

lines.japanese: 「聞けよう！」
lines.english: “Then listen!”

lines.japanese: 香田が肩をぶつけてきた。避けるのもめんどくさい、木漏れ日みたいなタックル。
lines.english: Koda bumped her shoulder against mine—a tackle like dappled sunlight, too feeble to bother dodging.

lines.japanese: 「ってえな。触れんなよ。うつんだろ、女くせえのが」
lines.english: “Ow. Don't touch me. You'll get girl stink all over me.”

lines.japanese: 俺は甘ったるい香水の臭いを払うように、てのひらで数回扇いだ。
lines.english: I fanned the air a few times, as if I could brush away the sugary perfume.

lines.japanese: 「えー？　なんでなんで、これダメなーん？」
lines.english: “What? Why? What's wrong with it?”

lines.japanese: 香田がほんのちょっと左手の袖を下ろして、手首を鼻に近づけた。くんかくんか。
lines.english: Koda tugged her left sleeve back just enough to bare her wrist, then brought it to her nose. Sniff, sniff.

lines.japanese: 「でじまー？　うーッそだ、かあいい匂いじゃんこれー」
lines.english: “For reals? No waaay. It smells cute!”

lines.japanese: くんかくんか、くんかくんか。唇をひん曲げて何度も鼻をすすっている。年頃の小娘相手にちょっと失言だったか。
lines.english: Sniff, sniff. Sniff, sniff. She twisted her mouth and kept smelling her wrist. Maybe that had been the wrong thing to say to a girl her age.

lines.japanese: 「あー、うん……まあ、いンじゃんそれで。そう、だって、どうせ俺そういうセンスないんだから。そーそー、俺が気に入るようなのは逆にヤバいかもしんない」
lines.english: “Yeah, okay... It's fine. I don't know anything about that stuff anyway. Really, if I liked it, that'd probably be a bad sign.”

lines.japanese: やつが気持ちしょんぼりしてしまったので、ガラにもなく取りつくろった。しょんぼりされちゃ仕方ない。俺はこう見えて、女子供のしょんぼりには弱いんだ。
lines.english: She looked a little crushed, so I did the unthinkable and tried to patch things up. I couldn't help it when someone looked that crushed. Believe it or not, I'm a sucker for women and kids looking crushed.

lines.japanese: 「で、なんだっけ。まとめると要は、最近おまえ、森里と上手くいってねーってことか」
lines.english: “So where were we? Basically, you and Morisato haven't been getting along lately?”

lines.japanese: 「ぁぁぁぁ……」
lines.english: “Aaaaaah...”

lines.japanese: 「なに。どーした、口開いてんぞ」
lines.english: “What? What's wrong? Your mouth's hanging open.”

lines.japanese: 「もっ、マジ疲れんですけど！　ほんっと隼人君、ひとの話に耳をレンタル出さないよね。どーなん？　そおゆう態度、社会人としてどーなん？」
lines.english: “God, you are seriously exhausting! You really never rent those ears out to anybody, do you? What is with that attitude? What kind of working adult acts like this?”

lines.japanese: 「すいません。マジすいません」
lines.english: “Sorry. Seriously, sorry.”

lines.japanese: 俺はブッ殺すぞと同じ語調で挑戦的に謝罪した。
lines.english: I apologized in the same combative tone I used for ‘I'll fucking kill you.’

lines.japanese: 返ってきたのは、反抗期の子を持つ母のような溜息だった。
lines.english: She answered with the sigh of a mother raising a rebellious child.

lines.japanese: 「ね、基本的なこと聞いてい？」
lines.english: “Can I ask you something basic?”

lines.japanese: 香田は重心を右足から左足へ移し、空いてる方の手を脇腹へ当てた。俺は気圧されたように頷く。やつは片方の眉を下げ、責めるような声で言った。
lines.english: Koda shifted her weight from her right foot to her left and planted her free hand on her hip. Somehow cowed, I nodded. One eyebrow dipped, and accusation entered her voice.

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、ぶっちゃけ私のこと嫌ってる？」
lines.english: “Be honest, Hayato. Do you hate me?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 俺は頭を前へ突きだしたあと、そのまま斜めに傾けて考えた。苦手ではあるが、たぶん嫌いではない。俺は答えた。
lines.english: I poked my head forward, then tipped it sideways to consider. I wasn’t exactly comfortable around her, but I probably didn’t hate her. I answered.

lines.japanese: 「べつに」
lines.english: “Not really.”

lines.japanese: 「いまの間はなに」
lines.english: “What was that pause?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、深い意味は」
lines.english: “It didn't mean anything.”

lines.japanese: 「怒んないから正直に言ってみ。嫌いなんでしょ」
lines.english: “I won't get mad. Just be honest. You hate me, right?”

lines.japanese: 「正直にィ……？」
lines.english: “Be honest...?”

lines.japanese: 俺はふたたび首をひねって考えてみた。
lines.english: I cocked my head the other way and considered it again.

lines.japanese: 「……いや、やっぱべつに」
lines.english: “...No. Still not really.”

lines.japanese: 「だからその間は何なん」
lines.english: “Then what was that pause?”

lines.japanese: 「だから深い意味はねーんだって。どんな質問だって、いきなり振られたらフツーちょっとは考えんじゃん」
lines.english: “I said it didn't mean anything. Anybody needs a second when you spring a question on them out of nowhere.”

lines.japanese: 「もーそんな、いいよ、ほんとのこと言ったってー」
lines.english: “Come on. It's fine. You can tell me the truth.”

lines.japanese: 「しつけーな。なんだよ、嫌ってほしいのかよ」
lines.english: “Jesus, you don’t quit. What, do you want me to hate you?”

lines.japanese: 「そーじゃないけどお」
lines.english: “No, but...”

lines.japanese: 「ならいいじゃねーかよ、嫌いじゃねっつってんだから」
lines.english: “Then what's the problem? I said I don't hate you.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ好き？」
lines.english: “Then do you like me?”

lines.japanese: 「いやべつに」
lines.english: “Not really.”

lines.japanese: 「即答っ！？」
lines.english: “You answered that instantly!”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、俺は刹那のひらめきを重んじる男だからな」
lines.english: “Well, I’m a man who believes in the lightning bolt of first instinct.”

lines.japanese: 「で、でもどんな質問だって、いきなり振られたらフツーちょっとは考えるじゃん」
lines.english: “B-but anybody needs a second when you spring a question on them out of nowhere!”

lines.japanese: 「それはおまえのフツーだろ。俺のフツーは何事もビシッと即断即決、うだうだ迷ったりはしねーんだよ」
lines.english: “That’s your normal. My normal is making every call on the spot, sharp and decisive. I don’t stand around dithering.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ嫌い？」
lines.english: “Then do you hate me?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……べつ……に？」
lines.english: “No... not... really?”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ好き？」
lines.english: “Then do you like me?”

lines.japanese: 「いやべつに」
lines.english: “Not really.”

lines.japanese: 「くきぃーっ！」
lines.english: “Grrrrraah!”

lines.japanese: そしてやつはしばらく暴れた。
lines.english: Then she thrashed around for a while.

lines.japanese: だけど実際のところ、ひとりの人間に○か×かの単一的なラベルを貼るような作業は意外に難しい。フレグランスの好みほど単純なものじゃないんだ、ネタにでも逃げなきゃやってられない。
lines.english: But the truth was, reducing an entire human being to a single check mark or X was surprisingly difficult. People were more complicated than a preference in perfume. If I didn't escape into a joke, I couldn't deal with it.
